description: GENERIC C#-to-Rust mappings. These are properties of the two LANGUAGES, not of Renode, and hold for any corpus. This is the layer c2rust occupies for C: a bug here is a transpiler bug and its fix benefits every future file, so it is fixed here rather than worked around per project.
boundary: Nothing in this file may mention Renode, a peripheral, or a register. If a mapping needs project knowledge it belongs in a project rule file instead — that split is what keeps the transpiler reusable and the project rules small.

operators.note: IBinaryOperation.OperatorKind and IUnaryOperation.OperatorKind, recorded by the ingest. Without them a Binary node says only 'Binary' and no expression can be emitted.

deviations.csharp: wraps silently in an unchecked context
deviations.rust: panics in debug, wraps in release
deviations.mapping: arithmetic on register values emits wrapping_* explicitly
deviations.why: Recorded rather than assumed. Renode's peripherals rely on C# wrapping for counters and timers; a debug panic there would be a behaviour change the oracle would catch late and confusingly.
Noted because `&&`/`&` differ in short-circuiting in both languages, so the OperatorKind distinction must be preserved, not normalised.
Roslyn carries nullable annotations, but Renode is not annotated, so every reference is potentially null and blanket Option<T> would be noise. Deferred deliberately; see PLAN.md D4.

known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.bug: partial methods reported as having a body
known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.cause: used `!IsAbstract && !IsExtern`; a `partial void Foo();` declaration is neither
known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.impact: 5,123 methods (24.7% of the corpus) claimed a body and emitted nothing

known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.cause: keyed on the constructed generic; `WithFlag<DoubleWordRegister>` does not match the declaration `WithFlag<T>`
known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.impact: 1,109 register-DSL calls resolved as external, which would have made the entire work queue wrong

known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.cause: C# named arguments may skip earlier optionals
known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.fix: use IArgumentOperation.Parameter, which Roslyn already resolved
known_transpiler_bugs_fixed.impact: a register's name was read as its reset value
no expression could be emitted at all

statements.note: Statement structure, generic to C# and Rust. Covers 96% of statements directly under a Block in this corpus (ExpressionStatement 2384, Return 1268, Conditional 699, VariableDeclarationGroup 573).

ConditionalAccess.note: `x?.Foo()`. C# short-circuits on null; Rust's equivalent depends on whether x is Option<T>, which needs the nullability analysis deferred in D4. Emitted as a marked gap rather than a guess.

invocations.note: Generic method calls. A call on `this` becomes a self-call; a call on an object becomes a method call on the translated receiver. Project rules match FIRST, so an idiom like IRQ.Set can override this.
